notes: Ordinal 1 maps to the reading-year start date (default September 1). This dataset is the authoritative source of Scripture assignments; cadence figures below are documentation/validation only, not generation rules.

cadenceDocumentation.oldTestament: 1 pass through the Old Testament (excluding Psalms/Proverbs)
cadenceDocumentation.gospel: 4 passes through Matthew, Mark, Luke, John

corrections.issue: Psalms 137-140 were never read (12th pass gap)
corrections.fix: Ordinal 179 corrected to 'Psalms 136–140' to complete the 12th pass

corrections.issue: Proverbs fell one chapter-read short of 12 full passes (29-31 each read only 11x)
corrections.fix: Proverbs regenerated deterministically: resets to chapter 1 on the 1st of each calendar month, reads one chapter per day, and on the last day of the month reads from that day-of-month's chapter through 31 inclusive (e.g. day 30 of a 30-day month reads 30–31; Feb 28 reads 28–31).

corrections.issue: Matthew 1-2 and Luke 1-2 are read 5 times instead of 4 (Christmas swap side effect)
corrections.decision: Left as-is intentionally, per user decision. This is a known, accepted characteristic of the plan, not a data error.
